scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test tests
scripts.compile:rbxts: bun run generate:sample && rbxtsc -p tsconfig.roblox.json --type game
scripts.build:rbxl: bun run compile:rbxts && rojo build default.project.json -o figma-vide-preview.rbxl
scripts.serve: bun run compile:rbxts && rojo serve default.project.json
